name: FCX vs NEM Pair Trade: Ratio Z-Score & Mean-Reversion Signals
description: Analyzes the FCX/NEM price ratio using a 252-day rolling z-score to identify extreme dislocations (±1.5 std devs). Marks mean-reversion events when the z-score crosses back through zero after being extreme. Shows average forward returns (5d, 20d, 63d) for both long FCX (z < -1.5) and short FCX (z > +1.5) signals. Includes a detailed event table of every Long FCX entry (first crossunder of z = -1.5) with ratio, z-score, and 5d/20d/63d forward returns at each entry.
source:
# =============================================================================
# FCX vs NEM PAIR TRADE: RATIO Z-SCORE & MEAN-REVERSION SIGNALS
# =============================================================================
# Question: When does FCX get dislocated vs NEM, and does the ratio mean-revert?
#
# Methodology:
#   - Price ratio: FCX close / NEM close
#   - 252-day rolling z-score of the ratio
#   - Extreme signal: |z| > 1.5 (entry zone)
#   - Mean-reversion event: z crosses back through 0 after being extreme
#   - Forward returns on the ratio at 5d, 20d, 63d horizons
#
# Assets: assets=[] — both loaded via reference_stocks (no primary asset needed)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
fcx = reference_stocks(ticker='FCX')()
nem = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()

fcx_close = fcx.c
nem_close = nem.c

# --- Price Ratio ---
ratio = fcx_close / nem_close

# --- 252-Day Rolling Z-Score of the Ratio ---
ratio_mean = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)
ratio_std  = stddev(period=252)(ratio)

# Guard: only compute z-score when std is valid and non-zero (S02)
ratio_zscore = where(is_valid(ratio_std) and ratio_std > 0, (ratio - ratio_mean) / ratio_std)

# Safe z-score for display (0.0 when insufficient history)
z = ratio_zscore if is_valid(ratio_zscore) else 0.0

# --- Extreme Signal Detection ---
# Long FCX signal: z < -1.5 (FCX cheap relative to NEM)
is_long_fcx_extreme  = is_valid(ratio_zscore) and ratio_zscore < -1.5
# Short FCX signal: z > +1.5 (FCX expensive relative to NEM)
is_short_fcx_extreme = is_valid(ratio_zscore) and ratio_zscore > 1.5
# Either extreme
is_extreme = is_long_fcx_extreme or is_short_fcx_extreme

# --- Long FCX Entry Signal: FIRST bar z crosses below -1.5 (pulse, not persistent) ---
# crossunder fires exactly once per dislocation episode — the entry bar
is_long_entry = crossunder()(ratio_zscore, -1.5)

# --- Mean-Reversion Event: z crosses back through zero after being extreme ---
# Track whether we were in an extreme zone on the prior bar
was_extreme = is_extreme >> 1

# Zero-cross: z crosses above 0 (from negative extreme) or below 0 (from positive extreme)
z_cross_up   = crossover(ratio_zscore, 0.0)
z_cross_down = crossunder()(ratio_zscore, 0.0)
z_cross_zero = z_cross_up or z_cross_down

# Mean-reversion event = zero-cross that follows a prior extreme reading
# Use barssince to check if we were extreme within the last 63 bars (3 months)
bars_since_extreme = coalesce(barssince()(is_extreme), 999)
is_reversion = z_cross_zero and bars_since_extreme <= 63

# --- Forward Returns on the Ratio (for extreme entry signals) ---
# Using forward_returns on the ratio price series (safe — ratio is a price-like level)
fwd_5d  = forward_returns(period=5)(ratio)
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(ratio)
fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(ratio)

# Long FCX signal forward returns (z < -1.5 → expect ratio to rise)
long_fwd_5d  = where(is_long_fcx_extreme, fwd_5d)
long_fwd_20d = where(is_long_fcx_extreme, fwd_20d)
long_fwd_63d = where(is_long_fcx_extreme, fwd_63d)

# Long FCX ENTRY forward returns (only on the first crossunder bar)
entry_fwd_5d  = where(is_long_entry, fwd_5d)
entry_fwd_20d = where(is_long_entry, fwd_20d)
entry_fwd_63d = where(is_long_entry, fwd_63d)

# Entry z-score and ratio (for event marker display)
entry_zscore = where(is_long_entry, ratio_zscore)
entry_ratio  = where(is_long_entry, ratio)

# Short FCX signal forward returns (z > +1.5 → expect ratio to fall → negate for P&L)
# Negate because short FCX means you profit when ratio falls
short_fwd_5d  = where(is_short_fcx_extreme, -fwd_5d)
short_fwd_20d = where(is_short_fcx_extreme, -fwd_20d)
short_fwd_63d = where(is_short_fcx_extreme, -fwd_63d)

# --- Timestamps for reporters ---
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- CHART 1: Price Ratio with Rolling Mean (CONTEXT) ---
# Shows where the ratio is now vs its 1-year average
xy_lines(
    title='Is FCX Cheap or Expensive vs NEM Right Now?',
    category='FCX/NEM Pair Trade',
    order=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='FCX/NEM Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252d Mean', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    y_axis_label='FCX Price / NEM Price',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(ratio, ratio_mean))

# --- CHART 2: Z-Score with Extreme Bands (SIGNAL) ---
# The core signal: how stretched is the ratio vs its own history?
xy_lines(
    title='How Stretched Is the FCX/NEM Ratio vs Its Own History?',
    category='FCX/NEM Pair Trade',
    order=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score (252d)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Long FCX Entry', color=Color.Green, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),

    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=1.5, to=4.0, color=Color.Red, label='Short FCX Zone', opacity=0.08),
        PlotBand(from=-4.0, to=-1.5, color=Color.Green, label='Long FCX Zone', opacity=0.08)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0,  title='Mean',    color=Color.Gray,  dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.5,  title='+1.5σ',   color=Color.Red,   dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1.5, title='-1.5σ',   color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_axis_label='Standard Deviations from 252d Mean',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(z, where(is_long_entry, z)))

# --- EVENT MARKERS: Long FCX Entries (z crosses below -1.5 for the first time) ---
# Each marker = a new Long FCX entry episode begins
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Long FCX Entry',
        icon=Icon.ArrowDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Z-Score at Entry',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Hero
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='FCX/NEM Ratio',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=3,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Fwd Return 5d',
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Details
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Fwd Return 20d',
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Details
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Fwd Return 63d',
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Details
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                table_is_filter=True,
                table_visible=False
            )
        ]
    )
)(
    entry_zscore,
    entry_ratio,
    entry_fwd_5d,
    entry_fwd_20d,
    entry_fwd_63d,
    is_long_entry
)

# --- EVENT MARKERS: Mean-Reversion Crossings ---
# Each marker = z-score crossed back through zero after an extreme reading
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Mean-Reversion Signal',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Z-Score at Cross',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Hero
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='FCX/NEM Ratio',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=3,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Signal',
                type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge,
                card_color_map={"Success": ["Long FCX Reverted"], "Error": ["Short FCX Reverted"]}
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                table_is_filter=True,
                table_visible=False
            )
        ]
    )
)(
    z,
    ratio,
    where(z_cross_up, 'Long FCX Reverted') if z_cross_up else 'Short FCX Reverted',
    is_reversion
)

# --- CHART 3: Average Forward Returns by Signal Direction (PUNCHLINE) ---
# Does the pair actually mean-revert? Compare long vs short FCX signal outcomes
xy_bars(
    title='Does the Pair Mean-Revert? Avg Return After Extreme Z-Score',
    category='FCX/NEM Pair Trade',
    order=3,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward Return on Ratio (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5d',  color=Color.Blue,  stack='Long FCX (z < -1.5)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='20d', color=Color.Cyan,  stack='Long FCX (z < -1.5)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='63d', color=Color.Teal,  stack='Long FCX (z < -1.5)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5d',  color=Color.Blue,  stack='Short FCX (z > +1.5)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='20d', color=Color.Cyan,  stack='Short FCX (z > +1.5)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='63d', color=Color.Teal,  stack='Short FCX (z > +1.5)')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(values=(long_fwd_5d, long_fwd_20d, long_fwd_63d, short_fwd_5d, short_fwd_20d, short_fwd_63d))
